name: subagent-models-omp-sdk
description: Baseline for omp-native mode: the SDK version this code was written and tested against, with its lockfile. The gateway does not run from here: `cli.ts omp-sdk sync` installs the version matching the installed omp into ~/.local/share/subagent-models/omp-sdk/<version>/ (this lockfile is reused when the versions match).
